# Vishwakarma Build & Furnish

> Premium turnkey house construction, civil contracting, modern interior design, and custom furniture manufacturing based in Charkhi Dadri, Haryana.

## Information
- **URL**: https://vishwakarmabuildandfurnish.in/
- **Description**: Vishwakarma Build & Furnish offers premium end-to-end residential construction and contemporary interior design services. We specialize in modular kitchens, wardrobes, ceiling layouts, and custom woodwork.
- **Service Area**: Charkhi Dadri, Bhiwani, Mahendragarh, Rohtak, Jhajjar, Rewari, and nearby regions in Haryana, India.
- **Contact Phone**: +91-9416856468
- **Office Location**: Charkhi Dadri, Haryana, India

## Main Services
- **House Construction**: Complete structural design, layout planning, civil engineering, and turnkey construction with material options and structural guarantee.
- **Interior Design**: Customized modular kitchens (L-shape, U-shape, parallel layouts), false ceilings, PVC paneling, wallpaper, and home painting.
- **Custom Woodwork**: Modern designer wooden doors, windows, jali single/double doors, custom double beds, luxury sofa sets, and wardrobes.
- **Contractor Tenders**: Partners, suppliers, and contractors can view open civil tenders, submit quotes, or register as verified local business providers.
